summary: Split-screen New York City multi-branch store, express kiosk, and 24/7 ATM locator built strictly with modern, zero-deprecation Google Maps Platform APIs. On initial load, the app executes live Places API (New) Text Searches across NYC (Manhattan/Midtown center 40.7549, -73.9840, zoom 12) for real retail storefronts, coffee/food kiosks, and 24/7 ATMs, deterministically classifying each live Place into Flagship Store, Express Kiosk, or 24/7 ATM with inventory/service availability tags (Click & Collect, Express Espresso, Cash Deposit, Open 24h) while preserving live Google Place names, addresses, coordinates, ratings, and regularOpeningHours.weekdayDescriptions (never calling beta-only place.isOpen() on the weekly channel, and never hardcoding fake place data). A default NYC starting origin (e.g., Midtown / Penn Station 40.7506, -73.9935) is initialized immediately so the Routes API Route Matrix (RouteMatrix.computeRouteMatrix via importLibrary('routes') on client-only stacks; /api/routes/matrix on full-stack BFF stacks) computes live road ETAs and distances for all candidate branches on load and ranks the Fastest Nearby branch. Users can search a new starting origin using Places API (New) Autocomplete (AutocompleteSuggestion.fetchAutocompleteSuggestions + AutocompleteSessionToken + Place.fetchFields, with Geocoder fallback), switch travel modes (DRIVE, WALK, TRANSIT), and filter by branch type and service availability. Nearby markers are grouped cleanly at zoom 12 via @googlemaps/markerclusterer (MarkerClusterer + SuperClusterAlgorithm + custom AdvancedMarkerElement cluster renderer) and expand into distinct, custom-styled AdvancedMarkerElements (required mapId: 'DEMO_MAP_ID' and internalUsageAttributionIds: ['gmp_git_agentsamples_v1.0.0']) when zoomed in or when a cluster is clicked. Selecting any branch card, marker, or the 'Route to Fastest' CTA highlights the branch and renders the live route polyline via Route.computeRoutes (createPolylines()) or /api/routes/compute.
seed_search_query: flagship retail store, espresso kiosk, and 24/7 ATM in Manhattan, New York
ui_layout_summary: Responsive split-screen layout: (1) Top header bar (64px) featuring app branding, NYC starting-location Places Autocomplete search box (data-testid='origin-search-input') with prediction dropdown (data-testid='autocomplete-dropdown') and quick NYC origin preset, travel mode selector (DRIVE / WALK / TRANSIT), and 'Route to Fastest' CTA button; (2) Left scrollable sidebar (420px width on desktop, full-width drawer/panel on mobile) with branch-type filter chips (All, Flagship Store, Express Kiosk, 24/7 ATM), product/service availability toggles (Click & Collect, Express Espresso, Cash Deposit, Open 24h), active route summary banner showing selected/fastest branch ETA and distance, and interactive branch cards showing live Place name, address, type badge, inventory availability tags, live opening hours/rating, and live road ETA + distance; (3) Right full-height interactive Google Map container (flex-1, min-height: 560px, height: calc(100vh - 64px)) displaying MarkerClusterer clusters at city zoom, distinct custom AdvancedMarkerElement pins per branch type when zoomed in, origin pin, active route polyline, InfoWindow summary on selection, and a floating bottom-right legend + zoom hint.

backend_proxy_endpoints.purpose: Fetch live NYC candidate flagship stores, express kiosks, and 24/7 ATMs via Places API (New) Text Search on initial load and search refresh.
Provide NYC-biased starting location autocomplete predictions via Places API (New) with sessionToken pass-through.
Resolve selected Place ID coordinates/address for the origin or fetch live branch opening hours and details.
Compute live road travel times and distances from the customer origin to all candidate branches to rank and badge the fastest nearby branch.
Compute the optimal route geometry (encodedPolyline), travel duration, and distance from the customer origin to the selected branch.
